paper_title: Lattice QCD input for axion cosmology
suggested_experiment_name: Lattice QCD axion cosmology (DIGM/IILM misalignment bound)
coupling_convention: T1/Tc temperature ratio (dimensionless, linear axis) — NOT axion mass; this figure plots the rolling temperature T1/Tc vs f_a, there is no m_a-vs-f_a exclusion plane in the paper
notes: Lattice QCD (pure SU(3) Yang-Mills) calculation of temperature-dependent topological susceptibility used to derive an axion cosmology bound via the misalignment mechanism (post-inflation PQ breaking). Main result: f_a <= (4.10 +/- 0.04)e11 GeV, equivalently m_a >= (14.6 +/- 0.1) ueV. This is a single-point cosmological/theoretical bound on the f_a-m_a relation, not a coupling-vs-mass exclusion curve. Encoded as one point [m_a=1.46e-5 eV, f_a=4.10e11 GeV]. Not a haloscope DM search, so no local DM density.
